description.en: Same as CreateMonologue, but first computes the score difference between the two match teams (player score minus opponent score, plus one) and substitutes it into the message via CMND_MESSAGE_REPLACE_VAL — used for a "comeback" narration line referencing the current score gap.
Screen buffer to draw the monologue box on.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Show a comeback-narration monologue referencing the current score gap
CreateMakikaeshi("ev100", SCREEN_A);
